sources: Infinity RPG O-12 Sourcebook MUH050220, character creation pp.83–92
Infinity RPG Corebook MUH050206, career Lifepath p.53 and inherited careers pp.61–69
features: 12 source-aligned O-12 Career profiles with first-phase-only attributes
Mandatory/elective/signature skill training in phase ledger
Life Point budget, costs for extra phases, assignment choice, Faction Table rolls and event selection
Bureau Analyst and Aegis Unit rolls; repeat roles require D1 career hazard confirmation or 1 Life Point
Explicit Criminal Record with forced Beta Unit and post-phase clearance
O-12 Adolescent/Career Event routes and unambiguous numeric outcomes
Pillar effects and Social Status modifier ledger
Safe gear grants; manual deferral for ambiguous or missing items
Phase undo, non-O12 bonus isolation, autosave/JSON/XML and existing print-rating integration
Embedded one-file parity with standalone app/data
limitations: Earnings and final Social Status cannot be calculated without career dice and earlier Lifepath choices
Contacts, non-numeric outcomes, traits, conditional event consequences, talent prerequisites remain GM/player tasks
Core A/B/C events and Music of the Spheres recursive events are not auto-resolved
Careers are opt-in and do not change existing character data merely by changing Career
Unchosen gear alternatives and armour with locational soak require manual selection
These are synthetic runtime and static parity checks, not interactive full-browser end-to-end testing

Second career adds ranks but not attributes
Third phase + changed assignment charges 2 LP
Criminal Record forces Beta no charge
Core Field Scientist and adolescence stats
